design_overview: A modern, patient-centric hospital appointment booking system designed for both mobile and web platforms. The interface prioritizes clarity, ease of navigation, and accessibility for users of all ages. The design uses a calming medical color palette with blue as the primary color to evoke trust and professionalism. The UI follows native mobile patterns with bottom navigation for patients and a clean dashboard approach for doctors. Each screen is designed to minimize cognitive load while providing all necessary information at a glance. The design supports three user roles (Patient, Doctor, Administrator) with role-specific interfaces optimized for their unique workflows.

responsive_design: The design follows a mobile-first approach optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All touch targets meet minimum 44x44px accessibility standards. Cards and lists use flexible layouts that adapt to screen width. Typography scales proportionally. On tablet devices (768px+), the layout shifts to a two-column grid for doctor lists and appointments, with persistent side navigation replacing bottom navigation. Web version (1024px+) uses a three-column layout with sidebar navigation, main content area, and contextual sidebar for quick actions and summaries. All interactive elements maintain consistent spacing and sizing across breakpoints.
accessibility: The design follows WCAG 2.1 AA standards. All text meets minimum contrast ratios (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text). Interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. All icons are accompanied by text labels. Form inputs include clear labels and placeholder text. Error states use both color and text to convey information. Screen reader support includes semantic HTML structure, ARIA labels for icon-only buttons, and proper heading hierarchy. Focus indicators are visible for keyboard navigation. Color is never the sole means of conveying information (status badges include text). All images include alt text. The app supports dynamic text sizing and respects system accessibility settings.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (right-to-left for forward navigation, left-to-right for back). Card taps show 100ms scale animation (0.98 scale) for tactile feedback. Button presses show 150ms color transition. Loading states use skeleton screens with subtle shimmer animation. Success confirmations show 400ms fade-in with checkmark icon. Modal overlays fade in over 200ms with backdrop blur. List items animate in with staggered 50ms delays when loading. Pull-to-refresh uses native platform patterns. Time slot selection shows 200ms color transition. Bottom navigation icons scale slightly (1.1x) when tapped. All animations respect system reduced-motion preferences.
icons: Icons follow a consistent outline style with 2px stroke width. Primary icons used: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (ribbon), heart (health/favorites), filter (funnel), plus (add/create), edit (pencil), trash (delete), share (share arrow). Icons are 24px by default, 20px in compact contexts, 32px for prominent actions. All icons are monochrome, inheriting text color or using primary blue for active states. Icons are never used alone without text labels except in bottom navigation where labels are directly below. Icon set is sourced from a single library (Heroicons or similar) for visual consistency.
